patch_description:
The current approach uses 10 initializers, 1700 broad iterations per initializer, a single 1200-step polish, soft-extrema sharpness schedules of approximately 5–260 and 55–500, fixed momentum, and exact-score checkpointing only. The new configuration retains the successful staggered-hexagon family but uses fewer broad continuations and spends more effort around the best contact graph.

The main addition is deterministic geometry-aware restart polishing. Perturbations are constructed from the gradient induced by near-minimum and near-maximum pair bands, with orthogonal seeded noise added at amplitudes 0.003–0.015. This targets the active shortest and farthest contacts directly rather than relying only on isotropic noise. Refinement also adds rollback after repeated exact-score regressions, uses a wider late sharpness range, and finishes with a high-sharpness active-contact continuation.
